items.title: How to Buy a Rare Watch Direct From the Maker – and Skip Auction Prices
items.snippet: Independent watchmakers only produce a few dozen timepieces a year – and they don’t sell them to just anyone. Here's the playbook for getting into the workshop and onto the order book.

items.title: Mama Shelter arrives in Africa, on the day it opens in Mexico City
items.snippet: Mama Shelter opens its first hotel on the African continent on 1 December, in Cape Town, at 111 Bree Street. On the same day, Ennismore's brand inaugurates its first address in Latin America, in Mexico City.

items.title: Leonardo’s UK Loss Shows the Cost of Renting Hotels
items.snippet: Skift Take: Leonardo's UK hotels are making money from guests, but not enough to cover the rent. With costs rising and more rooms coming onto the market, the lease-heavy model that let hotel groups expand fast in the UK is starting to look like a liability.

items.title: Hotel Tech’s Shelf Reaches 1,900 Products, Everyone Courts the Small-Company Traveler, and Promises Go Missing Between Sales and Operations
items.snippet: Friday closed the week with a count of nearly 1,900 hotel technology products on the shelf, and a look at who now sells rooms to the business travelers that small companies send out on their own.

items.title: Vadodara plans crocodile-themed bridge at Sayajibaug
items.snippet: The Vadodara Municipal Corporation (VMC) is planning a INR 12.70-crore crocodile-themed foot overbridge across the Vishwamitri River inside Sayajibaug (Kamatibaug), designed to serve as a city landmark and wildlife-viewing attraction. The proposed bridge will replace the existing footbridge connecting the bird house with the lion and tiger enclosures.

items.title: West Bengal set for INR 75,000 cr highway expansion
items.snippet: Union Minister for Road Transport and Highways Nitin Gadkari has announced a pipeline of National Highway and road infrastructure projects worth approximately INR 75,000 crore for West Bengal. The announcement was made at a programme in Kolaghat, East Medinipur, where the minister inaugurated and laid the foundation stones for 22 National Highway projects worth more than INR 8,700 crore.

items.title: Legacy, innovation and expertise drive hotel’s growing MICE leadership in Delhi NCR
items.snippet: Hyatt Regency Delhi continues to reinforce its position as one of Delhi NCR’s leading destinations for meetings, incentives, conferences and exhibitions. With more than four decades of hospitality experience, the hotel combines institutional expertise with contemporary event infrastructure, personalised service and innovative venues such as The Mansion.

Onyxx Nature Resort opens near Jim Corbett National Park, targets destination weddings and MICE
items.snippet: Onyxx Nature Resort has announced its official launch with a wedding celebration at its property in Village Chhoi, Ramnagar, near Jim Corbett National Park in Uttarakhand. Positioned as a boutique four-star property, the resort features 54 rooms and approximately 58,000 sq. ft. of event space, catering to destination weddings, leisure travellers, families and corporate groups.
